settings.heading: Sell or trade your cards
settings.body: Bring it to a show or send photos. We buy singles, slabs and sealed — fair offers, paid fast.

settings.question: What do you buy?
settings.answer: Singles, graded slabs and sealed product — any size collection.

settings.question: How do I get an offer?
settings.answer: Send clear photos of the fronts and backs, or bring your cards to a show. We reply fast.

settings.question: How do you pay?
settings.answer: Cash at shows, or bank transfer — paid promptly once we agree a price.
